description: List the Edgegap agent skills: tested, step-by-step workflows for getting a multiplayer game online on Edgegap, with templates (Dockerfiles, matchmaker configs, Unity C# and Unreal C++ drop-ins) and known pitfalls. Each entry says which engine, netcode or backend it is for, and the server instructions map projects to skills. Before working on a game project, load the matching skill with edgegap_get_skill; "edgegap" covers any other engine and routes to the rest. Also says whether a newer skills pack is on GitHub (reads one version number, no Edgegap API call).
name: edgegap_list_skills
title: List the Edgegap agent skills
